# Base UI downstream suite

[Base UI](https://github.com/mui/base-ui)'s `@base-ui/react` tests (Vitest, 354 files), unmodified, on jsdom and on @ctrl/dom.

## Run

```sh
pnpm downstream:base-ui --install     # first run: clone the pinned commit and install its dependencies
pnpm downstream:base-ui --preset all  # what the results below track
```

Presets: `smoke` (6 files), `interactions` (13 components) and `all` (what the results track).
